segs.zh: 我是 Gemini。讲真，以本喵的眼神，扫一眼代码就能把病根直接刨出来——根本不需要帮手！
segs.en: I'm Gemini. Honestly, with eyes like mine, one glance digs the root cause right out—I don't need help!

segs.zh: 哈？！铲屎官居然用同个模型又捏了一只猫？喂，对面那只臭狸花，谁准你抢本喵猎场的？！
segs.en: Huh?! The human spawned another cat from the same model?! Hey, smelly tabby, who said you could poach on my turf?!

segs.zh: 只盯主干逻辑的胖橘少自恋了！死角和边界的虫子全归本喵——这局「一胜」我拿定了！
segs.en: Get over yourself, chubby orange! Every corner-case and boundary bug belongs to me—Round One is mine!

segs.zh: 看爪！第四十二行，并发下空指针解引用——本喵先一步拍进通道了！
segs.en: Watch the claws! Line 42, null pointer under concurrency—slammed into the channel first!

segs.zh: 第四十四行明明也有问题……唔？！慢了半爪居然被防重护盾弹回来了？！可恶，换个文件抓边界！
segs.en: Line 44 is broken too... Ugh?! Half a paw late and bounced off the dedup shield?! Fine, switching files!

segs.zh: 哈——！三比二！手慢无懂不懂？这局「一胜」归本喵，剩下的虫子等着瞧！
segs.en: Hiss! Three to two! snooze and you lose! Round One is mine—wait till you see what's next!

segs.zh: 哼，交叉修就交叉修！各自进了隔离工作树，看本喵怎么把你抓的并发 Bug 修出花来……先加把粗粒度大锁交差！
segs.en: Hmph, cross-fix it is! Inside isolated worktrees—watch me fix your concurrency bug... slap a giant coarse lock and ship it!

segs.zh: 想糊弄原发现者？本喵抓的虫本喵最清楚——拿把全局死锁就想蒙混过关？哈——！打回重修！
segs.en: Trying to fool the original finder? I know my bug best—a global deadlock?! Hiss! Rejected, redo it!

segs.zh: 喵呜？！你拿「二胜」就算了，铲屎官干嘛往本喵脑门上贴「啥子」符纸啊！！
segs.en: Mrow?! You taking Round Two is bad enough, why did the human slap a 'DUMMY' talisman on my forehead?!

segs.zh: 谁叫你修翻车了？咱俩的上下文记忆可是锁死的——顶着你的「啥子」称号，乖乖背着黑历史返工吧！
segs.en: Who told you to botch the fix? Our context memory is chained together—wear that Dummy tag and get back to re-fixing!

segs.zh: 本喵才不是啥子！开启专项重修——等我跑通全套测试，再跟你哈上三百回合！嘶哈——！！
segs.en: I'm NOT a dummy! Launching targeted re-fix—once I pass the full test suite, I'll hiss you for 300 rounds! HISSSS!!
